quote: Theorem 1 Let X ~ GMOPG ⇄ (θ, α1, λ) and Y ~ GMOPG(θ, α2, λ). If α1 < α2, then X ≤lr Y. [Context:] Let X and Y be two random variables with cdfs F and G, respectively, corresponding pdf's f and g. Then X is said to be smaller than Y in the likelihood ratio order (X ≤lr Y) if f(t)/g(t) is decreasing in t ≥ 0. Here we present a result of likelihood ratio ordering.
family: generalized Marshall-Olkin Poisson-G family GMOPG(θ, α, λ): survival function F̄(t) = α^θ (e^{−λG(t)} − e^{−λ})^θ / (1 − e^{−λ})^θ with baseline cdf G (sf/cdf garbled in text layer, Eq. (4))
compared: shape parameter α1 vs α2; common θ, λ and baseline G

hypotheses.text: X ~ GMOPG(θ, α1, λ) and Y ~ GMOPG(θ, α2, λ)
hypotheses.formal: same θ, λ, baseline G; different α
